detector_criteria.candidate_gate: no candidate unless 3 independent corpus families, basis-free rediscovery, holdout gain, ablation loss and falsifier are all present
detector_criteria.negative_holdout_false_positive_ceiling: at most 0 of 2 negative holdouts detected

detector_criteria.positive_holdout_floor: at least 1 of 2 positive holdouts detected
